Three.js r180 (0.180.0), official distribution from https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180/build.

The two minified ES modules are kept together because three.module.min.js imports three.core.min.js. Both load only on the mug customizer page. No CDN request is needed at runtime.
